contentText: Videos of Wednesday's fatal shooting of Renee Nicole Good by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent in Minneapolis have led to anti-ICE protests across the country, while putting Minnesota officials sharply at odds with the Trump administration. Nicole Sganga talks with former Minneapolis Mayor Sharon Sayles Belton about the reaction to the killing of Good (a 37-year-old mother of three), and why she says it is a time for action.
